sources.title: Media Fragments URI 1.0 (basic)
sources.observed_operation: Direct open and find in W3C Recommendation; reopened in bounded batch
sources.governing_condition_or_default_or_except: Temporal NPT uses seconds by default, permits fractional seconds and a colon time form; intervals are half-open. The colon form is a convenience and does not signal frame accuracy; empty or reversed ranges are invalid.
sources.applicability: Supports an interoperable interval convention and timing vocabulary, not local identity, UI or seek precision.

sources.title: Web Annotation Data Model
sources.observed_operation: Direct open and find in W3C Recommendation; reopened in bounded batch
sources.governing_condition_or_default_or_except: Defines annotation data/serialization and selectors; does not prescribe transport. FragmentSelector should name its fragment syntax. TextPositionSelector is brittle after edits and may be paired with State.
sources.applicability: Supports optional local interchange and transcript anchoring, not an application timing inference rule.

sources.title: HTML Standard: media elements
sources.observed_operation: Direct open and find in WHATWG Living Standard; reopened in bounded batch
sources.governing_condition_or_default_or_except: Media times are seconds; duration can be NaN or Infinity. Seeking is asynchronous; an out-of-range seekable target can be moved to a nearest seekable position. fastSeek trades precision for speed; precise seeking uses currentTime.
sources.applicability: Supports an adapter/readback/tolerance example. It does not prescribe behavior for the unspecified desktop player.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Slider Pattern
sources.version_or_commit: Live APG page as accessed 2026-10-12; no release tag
sources.locator: Keyboard Interaction lines 33–41; Media Seek Slider example lines 29–32; AT test note lines 25–26
sources.observed_operation: Direct open and find in W3C APG; reopened in bounded batch
sources.governing_condition_or_default_or_except: Defines arrow, Home/End and optional Page Up/Down interaction, and media time value text. It warns some touch AT support can vary and calls for AT testing.
sources.applicability: Supports an optional seek slider and manual accessibility validation, not interval editor completeness.

sources.title: WaveSurfer discussion #2737: playhead out of sync on long audio
sources.version_or_commit: Discussion dated 2023-03-21; reporter used WaveSurfer 6.6.1; closed unanswered
sources.locator: Issue description lines 142–165; maintainer/reporter replies lines 181–228
sources.observed_operation: Direct open and find in upstream discussion; reopened in bounded batch
sources.governing_condition_or_default_or_except: Reporter described increasing mouse-seek/playhead offset on long files. Maintainer suspected width calculation; reporter said a then-current alpha appeared to resolve it but raised compatibility concerns. No validated fix for 8.0.2 is established here.

sources.title: Peaks.js API documentation

sources.observed_operation: Direct open and find in version-pinned raw API; reopened in bounded batch
sources.governing_condition_or_default_or_except: Local waveformData/precomputed data and custom player are supported options; dataUri requests remote waveform data; multiChannel defaults false; keyboard defaults false; nudgeIncrement defaults to 0.01 seconds; segment events include pointer-drag inserts.
